newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin slips a cent on lower LME.
newsitem.headline: KL tin slips a cent on lower LME.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down one cent at 14.69 ringgit ($5.83) a kg after a lower London Metal Exchange close overnight discouraged buying, traders said.
"With no fresh leads in the market, the LME will continue to dictate the price here," said one trader. The tin price on the London Metal Exchange (LME) fell $45 on Monday.

Traders noted initial bids of 64 tonnes against offers of 107 tonnes. Final turnover was 79 tonnes, down from Friday's 130 tonnes, and were absorbed by European, Japanese and local interests, traders said.
The market was closed on Monday for a Hindu festival.
Traders said the local price should remain below 15 ringgit in the short-term as demand has not been encouraging.
The premium held by the local price over the LME has widened to $65 a tonne against $50 previously, the traders said.
